title: Write API tests with Vitest + supertest
description: Write comprehensive Vitest + supertest tests for all CRUD endpoints.
steps: Create tests/setup.ts for test database setup/teardown (in-memory SQLite)
Create tests/notes.test.ts with test suites for all 5 endpoints
Test GET /api/notes - empty list, then list after creates
Test GET /api/notes/:id - 404 for missing, 200 for existing
Test POST /api/notes - validation errors (empty title, too long), 201 success
Add npm test script runs vitest
Run tests to verify all pass
acceptance_criteria: npm test runs and all tests pass
Test coverage includes success + error paths for each of the 5 endpoints
